description: RefSite3D: A Multi-Phase and Multi-Scenario 3D Point Cloud Dataset from the Reference Construction Site Aachen for Target Extraction, Scan-to-BIM Verification and Construction Monitoring is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Jan Luca Fahrendholz-Heiermann, Sigrid Brell-Cokcan (RWTH Aachen University). RefSite3D is a multi-phase and multi-scenario construction progress monitoring dataset created within the TARGET-X project and further processed within the Cluster of Excellence CARE and the CARE Future Technologies Experimental Construction Site. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support building-stock, asset and facility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
